_meta.name: Issues and actions: demo register
_meta.disclaimer: Fictional demo data for the fictional firm CF Bank. Every finding, name, date and number is invented to show how the tracker works. It is not real audit or inspection output.
_meta.dates: All dates are offsets in days from the day the page is first opened (negative = in the past), so the demo always looks current.
_meta.links: control_ids refer to docs/data/controls.json, obligation_ids to docs/data/obligations.json.

issues.title: Customer identification evidence missing on sampled onboarding files
issues.description: A supervisory sample of 40 onboarding files found 9 where the identity document or the verification record could not be produced. Fictional finding.
issues.source_ref: Supervisory inspection letter, demo ref SI-2026-04

actions.title: Back-fill the 9 files and confirm identity evidence is retrievable
actions.evidence: Retrieval log attached to the case folder (demo reference BF-9).

actions.title: Make the onboarding workflow block completion without a verification record
Re-test a fresh sample of 40 files

issues.title: PEP book monitoring not performed for two consecutive quarters
issues.description: Enhanced ongoing monitoring of politically exposed persons has no test record and no review evidence. Fictional finding.

actions.title: Assign a named reviewer and a quarterly calendar slot
actions.evidence: Calendar invite series and delegation e-mail saved to the evidence folder.

actions.title: Complete the overdue reviews for the PEP book

issues.title: Four-eyes approval not evidenced for 6 of 25 sampled high-risk onboardings
issues.description: The approval step exists in the process but the second approver is not recorded in 6 of the sampled cases. Fictional control test result.

actions.title: Add a mandatory second-approver field to the onboarding tool

issues.title: Beneficial-owner discrepancies reported late to the registers
issues.description: Discrepancies found during onboarding were logged but reported later than internal procedure requires. Fictional finding.

actions.title: Add a discrepancy-reporting step with a time limit to the procedure

issues.title: Transaction monitoring thresholds not reviewed since go-live
issues.description: External reviewers noted the scenario thresholds were never re-calibrated against actual alert volumes. Fictional finding.
issues.source_ref: Independent effectiveness review, demo ref ER-2026-02

actions.title: Run a below-the-line threshold test on 6 months of data
Present tuning decisions to the compliance committee

issues.title: STR internal escalation log incomplete
issues.description: Escalations from the first line to the MLRO are recorded in e-mail only; the log has gaps. No control is mapped to this obligation yet. Fictional finding.

issues.title: Adverse-media vendor missed its screening turnaround several times
issues.description: The screening vendor exceeded the agreed turnaround on 14 occasions in the quarter. Fictional finding.

actions.title: Review the vendor SLA and agree a service-credit clause

issues.title: Dormant accounts are not reviewed as part of ongoing monitoring
issues.description: Accounts with no activity for 12 months fall outside the monitoring scenarios. The business judged the exposure low and the fix disproportionate for now. Fictional.

accepted.rationale: Fewer than 30 dormant accounts, all with zero balance; a manual annual sweep is in place. Re-assess at expiry.

issues.title: Manual overrides of onboarding decisions lack a written rationale
issues.description: Seven overrides in the last month had no rationale recorded. Fictional finding.

issues.title: Customer risk ratings not refreshed after trigger events
issues.description: Ratings stayed unchanged after address changes and adverse-media hits. Fictional finding.
issues.closure_note: Trigger-event rule live; retest of 25 files clean.

actions.title: Add trigger-event refresh rule to the CRA workflow
actions.evidence: Rule release note and test screenshots (demo).

issues.title: Onboarding team training completion below target
issues.description: Only 70 percent of the team had completed the annual AML module. Fictional finding.
issues.closure_note: Completion at 100 percent; reminder cadence set.

actions.title: Assign the module with a completion deadline and weekly reminders

issues.title: CDD failure cases without a documented decision on the relationship
issues.description: Cases where customer due diligence could not be completed did not always record the decision taken. Fictional finding.
issues.closure_note: Closed after a second retest; closure was 18 days later than target.

actions.title: Add a mandatory decision field to the CDD failure form

issues.title: PEP screening list refresh failed silently for two weeks
issues.description: A scheduled list update failed without an alert. Fictional control test result.

actions.title: Add job-failure alerting to the list refresh

issues.title: Purpose and nature of relationship fields blank in a share of files
issues.description: Free-text purpose field left blank or filled with placeholders in sampled files. Fictional finding.
issues.closure_note: Field made mandatory with a picklist; retest clean.

actions.title: Replace free text with a mandatory picklist plus comment

issues.title: Supervisor information request answered after the requested date
issues.description: A request for information was answered three days late because ownership was unclear. Fictional finding.
issues.closure_note: Single point of contact named; tracker for regulator requests in place.

actions.title: Name an owner and back-up for supervisory requests

issues.title: Sanctions list update batch failed twice in a quarter
issues.description: Two failed batch runs were fixed by IT without a compliance notification. Fictional control test result.
issues.closure_note: Monitoring and compliance notification added; two clean runs.

actions.title: Alert compliance on any failed list update
